pairs.description: One pair per fixed viewport label; PNG dimensions must agree within each pair. Max 60000 serialized input bytes.

baseline.description: Canonical base64 PNG, not a path/URL. <=10000 bytes; RGB/RGBA8 noninterlaced; IHDR/IDAT/IEND only; <=1280x960, <=1000000 pixels.

candidate.description: Canonical base64 PNG, same restrictions and dimensions as baseline.
